html:
Reflective window film is ideal for commercial buildings. It adds a modern, sleek look and provides the ultimate privacy. It can also help to prevent break-ins as expensive equipment that might otherwise have been seen by outsiders is no longer visible. Below we list the benefits of having reflective window tint applied to your home or office windows.

Tint a Home is Australia’s most trusted tinting network for car, home and office window tinting. We have been providing tinting services in Australia for over 42 years and specialise in home & office window tinting. Here are the benefits of reflective tint:

Benefits Of Reflective Window Tint

With all the benefits of reflective window tint, it really is such a wise choice for both residential and commercial buildings.

Benefits of reflective glass film include:

  • A more comfortable year-round temperature (reflective tint keeps your home cooler during summer and warmer in winter)
  • Reduces power bills – Reduces glare (no more annoying reflections on screens!)
  • Offers protection from harmful UV rays
  • Helps to prevent premature fading of flooring and furnishings

All reflective tint is installed by professionally trained installers. Our reflective window tint is exclusive to us and is government certified by ARPANSA to ensure the highest quality.

Reflective Tint For House Windows

Reflective tint is not only ideal for offices. You can also use reflective tint for house windows. If you have windows that face a street or overlook your neighbours, reflective glass film provides privacy without affecting the natural light entering your home. We offer a lifetime warranty on all residential applications (and up to 15 years for commercial applications).

Interest-free payment options are available through Afterpay and Zip Pay where you can split your purchase over 3, 6, 9, or 12 months with ZERO interest.

Get A Quote For Reflective Glass Film Today

Call 13 TINT or use our Store Finder to locate your nearest store to get a quote for reflective window tint. If you would like to know more about reflective glass film for your home or office, we will be able to answer any questions you have.
